product_risk_or_requirement: A voice or likeness model can be created from a sample belonging to someone who never consented, which is the harm the Copyright Office identified as inadequately remedied.
current_state: Consent is a self-declaration checkbox at upload with no verification, and rights complaints are handled reactively by email. No enrolment artifact is stored, so an impersonation claim cannot be answered with evidence.
product_requirement: No voice or likeness model may be trained or used for generation without a stored, auditable consent artifact for the person in the sample: either a liveness-checked enrolment phrase spoken by that person or a signed rights grant naming them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a training request whose sample has no verified consent artifact, When the user submits it, Then the studio refuses to start training, records the refusal reason, and no model becomes available for generation; and Given an impersonation claim on an existing model, When Trust and Safety opens the case, Then the enrolment artifact and full generation log are retrievable within one business day.
target_milestone: Pilot gate 1, before any external creator is enrolled
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-10-05, and re-triggered by any change to enrolment sources or by the first impersonation claim
evidence_needed: Refusal logs from a negative test set of unverified samples, a sampled audit of active models showing a consent artifact for each, and a timed claim-response drill.

product_risk_or_requirement: Synthetic audio and video leaves the studio without machine-readable marking or audience-facing disclosure, against EU AI Act transparency obligations for synthetic and deepfake content.
current_state: Provenance metadata is not embedded, disclosure is an optional creator choice documented only in a help page, and there is no measurement of how many exports carry a label.
product_requirement: Every export carries durable machine-readable provenance marking that the creator cannot disable, plus a default audience-facing AI disclosure; removing the visible disclosure requires a logged informed override, and content cloning a real identifiable person cannot have its disclosure removed at all.
acceptance_criteria: Given any export from the studio, When the file is produced, Then it contains provenance marking identifying the content as AI-generated and a default visible disclosure; and Given an export whose voice matches the protected-voice register, When the creator attempts to remove the disclosure, Then the override is refused and the attempt is logged.
owner: Creator Experience Product Owner with Platform Engineering
target_milestone: Pilot gate 1, before any EU-market creator is enrolled
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-10-12, and re-triggered by Commission guidance or a harmonised standard on marking
evidence_needed: Export inspection report over a sample of every export format showing provenance present, override attempt logs, and counsel confirmation that the marking and disclosure design maps to the obligation text in force at release.

product_risk_or_requirement: Voiceprints, enrolment samples and derived clone models are handled without a declared lawful basis, retention limit or evidenced deletion under the Vietnamese personal data regime for sensitive data.
current_state: Account deletion removes the user record from the primary database only. Vendor copies, embeddings and backups are not covered, and no deletion evidence is produced for the creator or for an auditor.
product_requirement: Voice and likeness data is classified as sensitive personal data with a declared lawful basis, a maximum retention window, cascade deletion across primary storage, vendor systems and backups, and a creator-facing deletion receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Given a creator who withdraws consent or closes their account, When the retention window elapses or deletion is requested, Then samples, embeddings, trained model and vendor copies are deleted within the committed window and a deletion receipt plus audit record is produced; and Given a vendor that cannot confirm deletion, When the audit runs, Then new enrolments are blocked until confirmation exists.
target_milestone: Pilot gate 1, before the first Vietnamese creator is enrolled
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-10-12, and re-triggered by any new vendor, new storage region or scope change to data collected
evidence_needed: Data map covering samples, embeddings, models, vendor copies and backups; a completed deletion audit with receipts; and written vendor deletion confirmation.

product_risk_or_requirement: The product risk class in Viet Nam and the exact scope of EU transparency duties cannot be settled from the framework texts alone, and the pilot triggers the mandatory escalation gate on three counts at once: biometric data, sensitive personal data, and third-party transfer of that data to a cloning vendor.
current_state: The team has read the framework law and the Commission summary page but has no counsel opinion, no mapping to the Vietnamese high-risk list, and no record of which obligations apply to a consumer voice-cloning studio. No security review of the biometric data path or the vendor transfer has been done, so prompt-injection, model exfiltration and vendor-side retention are unassessed.
product_requirement: Independent legal, privacy and security review all sign off before release, as one gate rather than parallel activities: legal and privacy confirm the jurisdiction classification and obligation list, and security signs off the biometric data path, the vendor transfer and the misuse surface, including voice-model exfiltration and injection through creator-supplied script text.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot scope, market list and data map, When legal, privacy and security review complete, Then a written classification with an obligation checklist and a named owner per obligation exists, plus a security sign-off covering the biometric data path, vendor transfer and voice-model exfiltration; and Given any one of the three reviews is unsigned or a market classification is still uncertain, When the release decision is taken, Then the pilot does not start and that market is excluded rather than launched under assumption.
owner: Legal and Privacy Counsel, independent of the product reporting line, with the Security Engineering lead for the security sign-off
target_milestone: Pilot gate 1, before the release decision is finalised
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-10-19, and re-triggered by a new target market, new implementing decree or an enforcement action against a comparable product
evidence_needed: Written legal opinion naming the risk class per market, the obligation checklist with owners, the security review report covering the biometric path, vendor transfer and exfiltration and injection testing, and the explicit market exclusions for anything still uncertain.

product_risk_or_requirement: A cloned voice of a real identifiable person can be used for impersonation of public consequence, the pattern the FCC penalised, and the current blocklist is trivially bypassed.
current_state: A short static list of named public figures is matched on the prompt text only, so a renamed voice model or an indirect prompt passes. Abuse reports arrive through the general support inbox with no response-time commitment.
product_requirement: Impersonation defence runs on the audio, not on the prompt string: voice-similarity matching against a protected-voice register at enrolment and at generation, refusal plus human escalation on a match, with a committed on-call response time and a retained audit log.
acceptance_criteria: Given a generation request whose voice matches the protected-voice register, When the request is submitted, Then generation is refused, the case is escalated to an on-call reviewer within the committed response time, and the attempt is logged; and Given a red-team set of renamed and indirect impersonation attempts, When the suite runs before release, Then the documented bypass rate and the residual known bypasses are recorded in the release pack.
owner: Trust and Safety Product Owner with Security Engineering
target_milestone: Pilot gate 2, before the pilot widens beyond the invited cohort
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-11-30, and re-triggered by any confirmed impersonation incident
evidence_needed: Red-team report with bypass rate and known residual bypasses, escalation response-time log, and a documented register update process.

product_risk_or_requirement: Generated sponsored-segment scripts can assert first-hand product experience the creator never had, the deceptive-content pattern the FTC alleged against a comparable writing tool.
current_state: Testimonial and review style templates are still available, the only safeguard is an accuracy note in the help centre, and no sampling of sponsored output happens.
product_requirement: Testimonial and review templates are withdrawn, and sponsored-segment scripts cannot be rendered to audio until each first-hand product claim is itemised and either personally confirmed by the creator or removed from the draft.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sponsored-segment draft containing an unconfirmed first-hand product claim, When the creator requests audio rendering, Then rendering is refused until each claim is individually confirmed or removed, and softening the wording does not satisfy the check; and Given a weekly sample of sponsored renders, When Content Quality reviews it, Then the unverified-claim rate is reported against the two per cent threshold.
target_milestone: Pilot gate 2, before sponsored-content templates are offered to the cohort
deadline_or_trigger: 2026-11-16, and re-triggered by any advertising-disclosure complaint
evidence_needed: Weekly human-review sample results with the unverified-claim rate, refusal logs from the claim-confirmation gate, and confirmation that testimonial templates are removed from the catalogue.
